resources.string: Blocks YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels by leaving the viewer and covering their buttons. The rest of each app keeps working.
AppBlocker requires Android\'s Accessibility Service API to detect and block short-form video feeds.
The app uses Android\'s Accessibility Service API only in YouTube and Instagram.
To know when you leave YouTube or Instagram, it also sees which app is on screen (app name only); nothing about other apps is stored or shared.
It reads limited screen structure (element IDs and positions), not messages or text.
It presses Back and draws covers.
Nothing leaves the device. There is no network access.
If the switch is greyed out: open App info → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings, then return.
Tap to open setup and enable protection service
